description: React component 'PromptInfoView' for displaying detailed information about a prompt, including overview, template, details, and raw JSON. It handles fetching prompt data, editing, copying, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: PromptInfoView
classes.description: React functional component displaying prompt details with tabs for overview, template, admin details, and raw JSON with capabilities to copy, edit, and delete prompts.

methods.name: fetchPromptInfo
methods.description: asynchronously fetches prompt data using getPromptInfo and updates the component state.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: formats a date string into localized string or returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: copies specified text to clipboard and updates UI state to indicate copy success.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: opens confirmation modal for prompt deletion.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: performs prompt deletion via deletePromptCall and shows success or error notifications.
